description: HydraShield Data Observatory — the data registry. Catalog records of datasets: status integrated | candidate | rejected. 'integrated' means the source is wired into a live pipeline path (status_note says where); 'candidate' means catalogued for evaluation — nothing is wired to it; 'rejected' means evaluated and declined with reason. Entries carry no implication of use unless status=integrated. Built 2026-08-17 from config/source_registry.json (29 source entries transformed; the two dual-dataset entries — EU-DEM+SRTM terrain, FIRMS VIIRS+MODIS, OSM ohsome+Overpass — were split into one record per dataset+access path, giving 32 transformed records) plus 23 new authoritative global candidates.
observatory_note: Entries are catalog records — status integrated/candidate/rejected; nothing here implies the data is wired into analysis unless status=integrated.

datasets.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (via Element84 Earth Search STAC)
datasets.license: Copernicus free and open data policy

datasets.provenance: Transformed from config/source_registry.json (audit 2026-08-17); STAC catalog live-checked 2026-08-17.
datasets.quality: Optical sensor — unusable under persistent cloud cover; L2A atmospheric correction applied by the producer.
datasets.status_note: Integrated: analysis (satellite), micro-area NDMI variability.

datasets.provenance: Transformed from config/source_registry.json (audit 2026-08-17); forecast endpoint live-called 2026-08-17.
datasets.quality: Numerical model output, not station observations; 850 hPa winds approximate the smoke-transport layer but ignore plume rise, vertical shear and chemistry.
datasets.status_note: Integrated: analysis (weather, FWI inputs), risk grid, snapshot, smoke transport (wind profile).
